q: (Only Allaah knows the correct meaning of these letters.)
v.s: Alif, Lām, Meem.
v.c: Alif-Lãm-Mĩm.

q: think that they will be left to say, “We have Imaan!” without being tested?
(In fact, the stronger the Imaan, the harder the test.)
v.s: Do the people think that they will be left to say, "We believe" and they will not be tried?
v.c: Do people think once they say, “We believe,” that they will be left without being put to the test?

m: And Allah will surely make evident
And Allah will surely make evident
and He will surely make evident
v.s: But We have certainly tried those before them, and God will surely make evident those who are truthful, and He will surely make evident the liars.
v.c: We certainly tested those before them. And ˹in this way˺ Allah will clearly distinguish between those who are truthful and those who are liars.

q: think that they can escape Us
(because none can ever escape Our punishment).
v.s: Or do those who do evil deeds think they can outrun [i.e., escape] Us? Evil is what they judge.
v.c: Or do the evildoers ˹simply˺ think that they will escape Us? How wrong is their judgment!

q: (the time stipulated by Allaah when He will meet people)
will certainly arrive. And He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.
v.s: Whoever should hope for the meeting with God - indeed, the term [decreed by] God is coming. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
v.c: Whoever hopes for the meeting with Allah, ˹let them know that˺ Allah’s appointed time is sure to come. He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

q: (fights the Kuffaar or his own passions)
(for his own benefit because he will attain the benefits and rewards).
Allaah is Independent of the entire universe
(and is not dependent on their worship or obedience). (He created us to confer blessing on us).
v.s: And whoever strives only strives for [the benefit of] himself. Indeed, God is Free from need of the worlds.
v.c: And whoever strives ˹in Allah’s cause˺, only does so for their own good. Surely Allah is not in need of ˹any of˺ His creation.

m: and We will surely reward them
q: Those who have Imaan and do good deeds, We shall definitely cancel
their sins from them and reward them
(because the rewards of the Aakhirah are everlasting).
v.s: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely remove from them their misdeeds and will surely reward them according to the best of what they used to do.
v.c: As for those who believe and do good, We will certainly absolve them of their sins, and reward them according to the best of what they used to do.

q: man to treat his parents kindly.
force you to ascribe partners to Me about which you have no knowledge
(about whom you have no proof that they deserve to be worshipped),
shall be to Me, when I shall inform you of what you used to do.
(Therefore, when anyone wants you to do something that displeases Me, do not obey them because you will ultimately have to answer to Me.)
v.s: And We have enjoined upon man goodness to parents. But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them. To Me is your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.
v.c: We have commanded people to honour their parents. But if they urge you to associate with Me what you have no knowledge of, then do not obey them. To Me you will ˹all˺ return, and then I will inform you of what you used to do.

q: those who have Imaan and who do good deeds among the righteous
(among the Ambiyaa ﵊ and other pious people with whom they will be raised on the Day of Qiyaamah).
v.s: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely admit them among the righteous [into Paradise].
v.c: Those who believe and do good will surely be admitted by Us into ˹the company of˺ the righteous.

q: who say, “We believe in Allaah!” Then, when they suffer any adversity
(as if it is as severe as)
will certainly say, “We were always with you
(and therefore also deserve a share of the booty).”
Does Allaah not know best what is in the hearts of all in the universe?
(Allaah knows well what is in the hearts of the Munaafiqeen and will punish them for their hypocrisy.)
v.s: And of the people are some who say, “We believe in God,” but when one [of them] is harmed for [the cause of] God, they consider the trial [i.e., harm] of the people as [if it were] the punishment of God. But if victory comes from your Lord, they say, “Indeed, We were with you.” Is not God most knowing of what is within the breasts of all worlds [i.e., all creatures]?
v.c: There are some who say, “We believe in Allah,” but when they suffer in the cause of Allah, they mistake ˹this˺ persecution at the hands of people for the punishment of Allah. But when victory comes from your Lord, they surely say ˹to the believers˺, “We have always been with you.” Does Allah not know best what is in the hearts of all beings?

m: And Allah will surely make evident
And Allah will surely make evident
And He will surely make evident
v.s: And God will surely make evident those who believe, and He will surely make evident the hypocrites.
v.c: Allah will certainly distinguish between those who have ˹sure˺ faith and the hypocrites.

q: The Kuffaar say to the Mu'mineen, “Follow our way and we will bear the burden of your sins
(we are prepared to suffer the punishment for your sins without you suffering any punishment).”
will not carry any part of their sins
(the sins of the Mu'mineen because each person will suffer the punishment of his/her own sins).
(and will never keep their word even if it were possible to bear the burden of other people's sins).
v.s: And those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Follow our way, and we will carry your sins." But they will not carry anything of their sins. Indeed, they are liars.
v.c: The disbelievers say to the believers, “˹Just˺ follow our way, and we will bear ˹the burden of˺ your sins.” But they would never ˹want to˺ bear any of the believers’ sins. They are simply lying.

m: and surely they will be questioned
q: They will certainly carry their own burdens
in addition to those of others
(whom they caused to sin, without the actual sinners being absolved of punishment).
And on the Day of Qiyaamah they will definitely be questioned about what they fabricated
(about the partners they attributed to Allaah).
v.s: But they will surely carry their [own] burdens and [other] burdens along with their burdens, and they will surely be questioned on the Day of Resurrection about what they used to invent.
v.c: Yet they will certainly ˹be made to˺ carry their own burdens, as well as other burdens along with their own. And they will surely be questioned on Judgment Day about what they used to fabricate.

q: to his nation, where he remained
for a thousand years less fifty years
(when they refused to accept his message and continued to harass him, he prayed to Allaah to destroy them. Consequently)
(to themselves by refusing to accept Imaan).
v.s: And We certainly sent Noah to his people, and he remained among them a thousand years minus fifty years, and the flood seized them while they were wrongdoers.
v.c: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, and he remained among them for a thousand years, less fifty. Then the Flood overtook them, while they persisted in wrongdoing.

q: (to remind them about the consequences of rejecting the Ambiyaa).
v.s: But We saved him and the companions of the ship, and We made it a sign for the worlds.
v.c: But We delivered him and those in the Ark, making it a sign for all people.

q: (as a Nabi to his community), (so remember the time)
when he said to his people, “Worship Allaah and fear
him. This is best for you if only you knew
v.s: And [We sent] Abraham, when he said to his people, "Worship God and fear Him. That is best for you, if you should know.
v.c: And ˹remember˺ when Abraham said to his people, “Worship Allah, and fear Him. This is better for you, if only you knew.

q: “Instead of Allaah, you merely worship idols and fabricate lies
(about Allaah by saying that your idols are His partners).
that you worship instead of Allaah do not have control of your sustenance, so seek your sustenance from Allaah, worship Him and show gratitude
to Him. To Him shall you be returned.”
v.s: You only worship, besides God, idols, and you produce a falsehood. Indeed, those you worship besides God do not possess for you [the power of] provision. So seek from God provision and worship Him and be grateful to Him. To Him you will be returned."
v.c: You worship besides Allah nothing but idols, simply creating lies ˹about them˺. Those you worship besides Allah certainly cannot give you any provision. So seek provision from Allah ˹alone˺, worship Him, and be grateful to Him. To Him you will ˹all˺ be returned.”

q: many nations have denied before you.
The duty of the Rasool is merely clear propagation
v.s: And if you [people] deny [the message] - already nations before you have denied. And there is not upon the Messenger except [the duty of] clear notification.
v.c: If you persist in denial, so did ˹many˺ communities before you. The Messenger’s duty is only to deliver ˹the message˺ clearly.

q: not see how Allaah originates creation
(the feat of creating them after their deaths)?
(so how can anyone deny that they will be resurrected?).
v.s: Have they not considered how God begins creation and then repeats it? Indeed that, for God, is easy.
v.c: Have they not seen how Allah originates the creation then resurrects it? That is certainly easy for Allah.

q: Say, “Travel in the lands and see how He
Indeed Allaah has power over all things
v.s: Say, [O Muhammad], “Travel through the land and observe how He began creation. Then God will produce the final creation [i.e., final development]. Indeed God, over all things, is competent.”
v.c: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Travel throughout the land and see how He originated the creation, then Allah will bring it into being one more time. Surely Allah is Most Capable of everything.

q: Allaah punishes whoever He wills and has mercy on whoever He wills. To Him shall you be returned
v.s: He punishes whom He wills and has mercy upon whom He wills, and to Him you will be returned.
v.c: He punishes whoever He wills, and shows mercy to whoever He wills. And you will ˹all˺ be returned to Him.

q: on earth, nor in the sky. Besides Allaah You have no Protecting Friend nor any Helper
v.s: And you will not cause failure [to God] upon the earth or in the heaven. And you have not other than God any protector or any helper.
v.c: And you cannot escape Him on earth or in heaven. Nor have you any protector or helper besides Allah.”

q: and meeting with Him will lose hope in My mercy
(on the Day of Qiyaamah when they will see the punishment for themselves)
and they shall have a torturous
v.s: And the ones who disbelieve in the signs of God and the meeting with Him - those have despaired of My mercy, and they will have a painful punishment.
v.c: As for those who disbelieve in Allah’s signs and the meeting with Him, it is they who will have no hope in His mercy. And it is they who will suffer a painful punishment.

q: (When Ibraheem ﵊ convincingly proved to his people that their idols were helpless, as mentioned in verses 58-67 of Surah 21),
that his people could give was to say, “Kill him or burn him!” Then Allaah saved him from the fire
(by commanding the fire to be cool and peaceful for him).
signs in this for people who have Imaan.
v.s: And the answer of his [i.e., Abraham's] people was not but that they said, "Kill him or burn him," but God saved him from the fire. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
v.c: But the only response of Abraham’s people was to say: “Kill him or burn him!” But Allah saved him from the fire. Surely in this are signs for people who believe.

q: said, “You have merely taken to worship idols because of your mutual love in this worldly life
(because of your love for certain good people, initially you made idols in their forms as a form of respect, but thereafter Shaytaan fooled you into worshipping them). (However, despite this love)
Soon, on the Day of Qiyaamah, you will oppose
each other and curse each other
(worshippers will curse their idols and vice versa).
Your abode shall be the Fire and you will have no helpers.
“(As Allaah saved Ibraheem ﵊ from the fire, so will He save you from the eternal fire so believe in Him.)
v.s: And [Abraham] said, "You have only taken, other than God, idols as [a bond of] affection among you in worldly life. Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers."
v.c: He said ˹to his people˺, “You have taken idols ˹for worship˺ instead of Allah, only to keep ˹the bond of˺ harmony among yourselves in this worldly life. But on the Day of Judgment you will disown and curse one another. Your home will be the Fire, and you will have no helper!”

q: (After trying in vain to convince his people after many years,)
(has commanded me to go, to Shaam).
He is certainly the Mighty, the Wise
(and knows what is best for me).'
v.s: And Lot believed him. [Abraham] said, "Indeed, I will emigrate to [the service of] my Lord. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
v.c: So Lot believed in him. And Abraham said, “I am emigrating ˹in obedience˺ to my Lord. He ˹alone˺ is indeed the Almighty, All-Wise.”

q: Ya'qoob ﵊, kept Prophethood and scriptures in his progeny
and granted him his reward in this world.
(In addition to this, he will also be rewarded tremendously in the Aakhirah because)
He shall certainly be among the righteous ones in the Aakhirah.
v.s: And We gave to him Isaac and Jacob and placed in his descendants prophethood and scripture. And We gave him his reward in this world, and indeed, he is in the Hereafter among the righteous.
v.c: We blessed him with Isaac and ˹later˺ Jacob, and reserved prophethood and revelation for his descendants. We gave him his reward in this life, and in the Hereafter he will certainly be among the righteous.

q: when he said to his people, “Indeed you people engage in an obscene act
which none in the universe has indulged in before you.”
v.s: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds.
v.c: And ˹remember˺ when Lot rebuked ˹the men of˺ his people: “You certainly commit a shameful deed that no man has ever done before you.

q: (in public)?” (Admitting that they were guilty of these evils),
that his people could give was to say, “Bring Allaah's punishment to us if you are from among the truthful
(if your threat of punishment is true).”
v.s: Indeed, you approach men and obstruct the road and commit in your meetings [every] evil.” And the answer of his people was not but they said, “Bring us the punishment of God, if you should be of the truthful.”
v.c: Do you really lust after ˹other˺ men, abuse the travellers, and practice immorality ˹openly˺ in your gatherings?” His people’s only response was to say ˹mockingly˺: “Bring Allah’s punishment upon us, if what you say is true.”

q: said, “O my Rabb! Assist me against those who cause corruption

(by punishing them).” (Allaah accepted his du'aa and sent angels to punish them. Before proceeding to punish them, Allaah instructed them to first meet Ibraheem ﵊ and to inform him that a son will be born to him).
v.s: He said, "My Lord, support me against the corrupting people."
v.c: Lot prayed, “My Lord! Help me against the people of corruption.”

q: When Our messenger angels came to Ibraheem ﵊ with the good news
(that he was to father a son by the name of Is'haaq ﵊),
said, “We are to destroy the inhabitants of this town
v.s: And when Our messengers [i.e., angels] came to Abraham with the good tidings, they said, "Indeed, we will destroy the people of that [i.e., Lot's] city. Indeed, its people have been wrongdoers."
v.c: When Our messenger-angels came to Abraham with the good news ˹of the birth of Isaac˺, they said, “We are going to destroy the people of this city ˹of Sodom˺, for its people have persisted in wrongdoing.”

q: “(How can you destroy these people when)
who is present in the town. We shall definitely rescue
except his wife. She will be among those left behind
(to suffer the punishment because she is one of the kuffaar).”
v.s: [Abraham] said, "Indeed, within it is Lot." They said, "We are more knowing of who is within it. We will surely save him and his family, except his wife. She is to be of those who remain behind."
v.c: He said, “But Lot is there!” They responded, “We know best who is there. We will certainly save him and his family—except his wife, who is one of the doomed.”

q: When Our messenger angels came to Loot ﵊
(to inform him about what was to take place),
by their presence and his heart was distressed
(troubled because he feared that his people would attempt to sodomise them).
(because we are angels and the people cannot harm us in the least). (We shall shortly destroy your people but)
you and your family, except your wife. She will be of those left behind
v.s: And when Our messengers [i.e., angels] came to Lot, he was distressed for them and felt for them great discomfort. They said, "Fear not, nor grieve. Indeed, we will save you and your family, except your wife; she is to be of those who remain behind.
v.c: And when Our messenger-angels came to Lot, he was distressed and worried by their arrival. They reassured ˹him˺, “Do not fear, nor grieve. We will surely deliver you and your family—except your wife, who is one of the doomed.

q: “We will send down on the people of this town a punishment from the sky
v.s: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient."
v.c: We are certainly bringing down a punishment from heaven upon the people of this city for their rebelliousness.”

q: Indeed We left behind in them
which is clear to those who have understanding
(making it clear to them that this is the plight of those who fail to believe in their Ambiyaa ﵊), (This was seen by the Makkans who went to Shaam.))
v.s: And We have certainly left of it a sign as clear evidence for a people who use reason.
v.c: And We did leave ˹some of˺ its ruins as a clear lesson for people of understanding.

q: He said, “O my people! Worship Allaah, hope for
the Last Day and do not spread corruption on earth
(by promoting dishonesty, gambling, interest and robbery).'
v.s: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship God and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."
v.c: And to the people of Midian ˹We sent˺ their brother Shu’aib. He said, “O my people! Worship Allah, and hope for ˹the reward of˺ the Last Day. And do not go about spreading corruption in the land.”

q: so an earthquake seized them and
v.s: But they denied him, so the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.
v.c: But they rejected him, so an ˹overwhelming˺ earthquake struck them and they fell lifeless in their homes.

q: the Aad and the Thamud, whose condition
actions for them and prevented them from the straight path even though they were people of deep insight.
v.s: And [We destroyed] ʿAad and Thamūd, and it has become clear to you from their [ruined] dwellings. And Satan had made pleasing to them their deeds and averted them from the path, and they were endowed with perception.
v.c: And the people of ’Ȃd and Thamûd ˹met a similar fate˺, which must be clear to you ˹Meccans˺ from their ruins. Satan made their ˹evil˺ deeds appealing to them, hindering them from the ˹Right˺ Way, although they were capable of reasoning.

q: Qaaroon, Fir'oun and Haamaan. Without doubt, Moosa ﵊ came to them with clear signs
(and refused to accept what he told them). (However, despite all their resources and wealth),
v.s: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment].
v.c: ˹We˺ also ˹destroyed˺ Korah, Pharaoh, and Hamân. Indeed, Moses had come to them with clear proofs, but they behaved arrogantly in the land. Yet they could not escape ˹Us˺.

q: each of them on account of his sin. Against one of them
was Swallowed by the ground and we drowned another
Allaah was never One to oppress them
(by punishing them without first sending guidance to them),
(by refusing to accept the guidance that came to them).
v.s: So each We seized for his sin; and among them were those upon whom We sent a storm of stones, and among them were those who were seized by the blast [from the sky], and among them were those whom We caused the earth to swallow, and among them were those whom We drowned. And God would not have wronged them, but it was they who were wronging themselves.
v.c: So We seized each ˹people˺ for their sin: against some of them We sent a storm of stones, some were overtaken by a ˹mighty˺ blast, some We caused the earth to swallow, and some We drowned. Allah would not have wronged them, but it was they who wronged themselves.

q: The example of those who adopt
besides Allaah is like the example of a spider who spins a web. Without doubt, the weakest of homes is the home
of the spider, if only they would understand.

(Just as the spider thinks that its web is the strongest home in the world, the Mushrikeen think that their gods are the most powerful. However, just as the spider's web can offer the spider no protection from even a gust of wind, the gods of the Mushrikeen also cannot give them any protection.)
v.s: The example of those who take allies other than God is like that of the spider who takes [i.e., constructs] a home. And indeed, the weakest of homes is the home of the spider, if they only knew.
v.c: The parable of those who take protectors other than Allah is that of a spider spinning a shelter. And the flimsiest of all shelters is certainly that of a spider, if only they knew.

q: Verily Allaah has knowledge of whatever they call to
besides Him. He is the Mighty, the Wise.
v.s: Indeed, God knows whatever thing they call upon other than Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
v.c: Allah surely knows that whatever ˹gods˺ they invoke besides Him are ˹simply˺ nothing. For He is the Almighty, All-Wise.

q: These are the examples that We coin
(to make them understand the truth). (However not, every person will not take heed because)
v.s: And these examples We present to the people, but none will understand them except those of knowledge.
v.c: These are the parables We set forth for humanity, but none will understand them except the people of knowledge.

q: Allaah has created the heavens and the earth in truth
(in perfect proportions and with perfect functions).
(a clear sign reflecting Allaah's great power)
v.s: God created the heavens and the earth in truth. Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
v.c: Allah created the heavens and the earth for a purpose. Surely in this is a sign for the people of faith.

q: which has been revealed to you and establish salaah. Verily salaah
(performed with all its conditions and etiquette)
behaviour and evil. Without doubt, the Dhikr of Allaah is greatest
(greater than other forms of worship that are devoid of Allaah's remembrance).
(and will reward you for every action carried out sincerely).
v.s: Recite, [O Muhammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish prayer. Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of God is greater. And God knows that which you do.
v.c: Recite what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish prayer. Indeed, ˹genuine˺ prayer should deter ˹one˺ from indecency and wickedness. The remembrance of Allah is ˹an˺ even greater ˹deterrent˺. And Allah ˹fully˺ knows what you ˹all˺ do.

q: Debate with the People of the Book only with in that
(which proves your standpoint without offending them);
except those of them who are unjust
(those who are obstinate, for it is best to leave them alone).
“We believe in what was revealed to us
and what was revealed to you
(through your Ambiyaa ﵊). (The essence of what was revealed to all the Ambiyaa ﵊ is that)
Our Ilaah and your Ilaah is One and
v.s: And do not argue with the People of the Scripture except in a way that is best, except for those who commit injustice among them, and say, "We believe in that which has been revealed to us and revealed to you. And our God and your God is one; and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him."
v.c: Do not argue with the People of the Book unless gracefully, except with those of them who act wrongfully. And say, “We believe in what has been revealed to us and what was revealed to you. Our God and your God is ˹only˺ One. And to Him we ˹fully˺ submit.”
v.h: Arguing with the People of the Book

q: (as We have revealed the Torah to Moosa ﵊ and the Injeel to Isa ﵊),
So those to whom We have given the Book
(in the Qur'aan because they are acquainted with divine scriptures),
and there are some of these people
who also believe in it. It is only the
v.s: And thus We have sent down to you the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān]. And those to whom We [previously] gave the Scripture believe in it. And among these [people of Makkah] are those who believe in it. And none reject Our verses except the disbelievers.
v.c: Similarly ˹to earlier messengers˺, We have revealed to you a Book ˹O Prophet˺. ˹The faithful of˺ those to whom We gave the Scriptures believe in it, as do some of these ˹pagan Arabs˺. And none denies Our revelations except the ˹stubborn˺ disbelievers.

q: were unable to recite any book, neither could you write with your right hand
(because you had not learnt to read or write from any person).
(had you been a person proficient in reading and writing),
(they would think that you yourself had written the Qur'aan).
v.s: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt.
v.c: You ˹O Prophet˺ could not read any writing ˹even˺ before this ˹revelation˺, nor could you write at all. Otherwise, the people of falsehood would have been suspicious.

q: (that prove that they are from Allaah)
in the hearts of those given knowledge
(those who commit the Qur'aan to memory and who understand it).
(those who oppress themselves by refusing to accept the truth)
v.s: Rather, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is distinct verses [preserved] within the breasts of those who have been given knowledge. And none reject Our verses except the wrongdoers.
v.c: But this ˹Quran˺ is ˹a set of˺ clear revelations ˹preserved˺ in the hearts of those gifted with knowledge. And none denies Our revelations except the ˹stubborn˺ wrongdoers.

q: (He will decide whether or not to allow me to demonstrate such miracles).
I am but one who clearly warns
(people about the consequences of rejecting Imaan and it is not my duty to force them to believe).”
v.s: But they say, "Why are not signs sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "The signs are only with God, and I am only a clear warner."
v.c: They say, “If only ˹some˺ signs had been sent down to him from his Lord!” Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Signs are only with Allah. And I am only sent with a clear warning.”

q: that we have revealed a Book
to you, which is recited to them?
(In addition to the Qur'aan being a timeless miracle on its own which proves the Prophethood of Rasulullaah ﷺ,)
There is certainly mercy and a reminder in it for those who have Imaan.
v.s: And is it not sufficient for them that We revealed to you the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] which is recited to them? Indeed in that is a mercy and reminder for a people who believe.
v.c: Is it not enough for them that We have sent down to you the Book, ˹which is˺ recited to them. Surely in this ˹Quran˺ is a mercy and reminder for people who believe.

q: Say, “Allaah suffices as a Witness between myself and yourselves.
(He is enough as Witness to my Prophethood even if you Kuffaar refuse to believe me.) (Allaah's testimony is beyond doubt because)
He knows what is in the heavens and the earth. Those who believe in falsehood and disbelieve in Allaah are
(who will suffer losses in both worlds).”
v.s: Say, "Sufficient is God between me and you as Witness. He knows what is in the heavens and earth. And they who have believed in falsehood and disbelieved in God - it is those who are the losers."
v.c: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Sufficient is Allah as a Witness between me and you. He ˹fully˺ knows whatever is in the heavens and the earth. And those who believe in falsehood and disbelieve in Allah, it is they who are the ˹true˺ losers.”

m: And they ask you to hasten
But it will surely come to them
q: (O Rasulullaah ﷺ! By the Kuffaar constantly asking when punishment will overtake them, it seems as if)
They seek to rush you with
punishment. If it were not for a prescribed term
(after which punishment will come to them),
the punishment would have certainly come to them
will definitely come to them suddenly when they do not perceive it
v.s: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. And if not for [the decree of] a specified term, punishment would have reached them. But it will surely come to them suddenly while they perceive not.
v.c: They challenge you ˹O Prophet˺ to hasten the punishment. Had it not been for a time already set, the punishment would have certainly come to them ˹at once˺. But it will definitely take them by surprise when they least expect it.

q: seek to rush you with the punishment
(demand it from you by repeatedly asking you when it will come)
(their punishment will certainly come to them in the Aakhirah when)
Jahannam will certainly surround the Kaafiroon.
v.s: They urge you to hasten the punishment. And indeed, Hell will be encompassing of the disbelievers
v.c: They urge you to hasten the punishment. And Hell will certainly encompass the disbelievers

q: when the punishment will envelope them from above and from beneath their feet
(and they will be unable to escape).
It will then be said to them, “Taste
v.s: On the Day the punishment will cover them from above them and from below their feet and it is said, "Taste [the result of] what you used to do."
v.c: on the Day the punishment will overwhelm them from above them and from below their feet. And it will be said, “Reap what you sowed.”

q: who have Imaan! Indeed My earth is vast
(and you do not have to remain in a place where you are prohibited from worshipping Me),
(if you are in such a place, make Hijrah to a place where you can)
v.s: O My servants who have believed, indeed My earth is spacious, so worship only Me.
v.c: O My believing servants! My earth is truly spacious, so worship Me ˹alone˺.

q: (Do not forget that life is short because)
Every soul shall taste death, after which you will all be returned to Us.
(Then it will be too late to say that you were unable to worship Me where you lived. Therefore, make Hijrah from evil to good before you leave this world.)
v.s: Every soul will taste death. Then to Us will you be returned.
v.c: Every soul will taste death, then to Us you will ˹all˺ be returned.

m: surely We will give them a place
q: As for those who have Imaan and who perform good deeds, We will certainly settle them in balconies of Jannah, beneath which rivers flow. There they shall live forever. What a grand
v.s: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - We will surely assign to them of Paradise [elevated] chambers beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers
v.c: ˹As for˺ those who believe and do good, We will certainly house them in ˹elevated˺ mansions in Paradise, under which rivers flow, to stay there forever. How excellent is the reward for those who work ˹righteousness!˺—

q: ...those who exercise Sabr and who trust only in their Rabb.
v.s: Who have been patient and upon their Lord rely.
v.c: those who patiently endure, and put their trust in their Lord!

q: How many are the animals that do not carry their own provision
(You should therefore have no fear of sustenance when you make Hijrah, leaving your possessions behind.)
(knows your needs and will fulfil them).
v.s: And how many a creature carries not its [own] provision. God provides for it and for you. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
v.c: How many are the creatures that cannot secure their provisions! ˹It is˺ Allah ˹Who˺ provides for them and you ˹as well˺. He is indeed the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

q: who created the heavens and the earth and who made the sun and the moon subservient
(submitting to His command and at the service of mankind),
to where are they wandering astray
v.s: If you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth and subjected the sun and the moon?" they would surely say, "God." Then how are they deluded?
v.c: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created the heavens and the earth and subjected the sun and the moon ˹for your benefit˺, they will certainly say, “Allah!” How can they then be deluded ˹from the truth˺?

q: sustenance for whoever He wills of His bondsmen
Verily Allaah has knowledge of all things.
(He knows exactly why some deserve more and others less.)
v.s: God extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts for him. Indeed God is, of all things, Knowing.
v.c: Allah gives abundant or limited provisions to whoever He wills of His servants. Surely Allah has ˹full˺ knowledge of everything.

q: who sends rain from the sky, thereby reviving the earth
(after it had been unable to bear anything),
they will certainly reply, “Allaah!” Say, “All praise belongs to Allaah”
(because it is He Who enables others to do something praiseworthy).
However, most of them have no understanding
(they fail to realise the contradiction in their beliefs).
v.s: And if you asked them, "Who sends down rain from the sky and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness?" they would surely say, "God." Say, "Praise to God"; but most of them do not reason.
v.c: And if you ask them who sends down rain from the sky, giving life to the earth after its death, they will surely say, “Allah!” Say, “Praise be to Allah!” In fact, most of them do not understand.

q: The life of this world is
Without doubt, the life of the Aakhirah is true
(If people understood this, they would not give preference to this world over the Aakhirah).
v.s: And this worldly life is not but diversion and amusement. And indeed, the home of the Hereafter - that is the [eternal] life, if only they knew.
v.c: This worldly life is no more than play and amusement. But the Hereafter is indeed the real life, if only they knew.

q: (which is struck by bad weather and then threatens to sink),
(knowing that only He can save them).
to land, they again begin to ascribe partners to Him...
v.s: And when they board a ship, they supplicate God, sincere to Him in religion [i.e., faith and hope]. But when He delivers them to the land, at once they associate others with Him
v.c: If they happen to be aboard a ship ˹caught in a storm˺, they cry out to Allah ˹alone˺ in sincere devotion. But as soon as He delivers them ˹safely˺ to shore, they associate ˹others with Him once again˺.

q: (they do it so that they may continue)
(their lives in this world without having to regulate their lives with Allaah's commands).
(when punishment afflicts them in this world or in the Aakhirah)
v.s: So that they will deny what We have granted them, and they will enjoy themselves. But they are going to know.
v.c: So let them be ungrateful for all We have given them, and ˹let them˺ enjoy themselves ˹for now˺! For they will soon know.

q: made the Haram a place of safety
(a place where the Arabs regarded killing for any reason to be forbidden),
(in this manner, the people of Makkah were always safe from attack)?
(to them)? (Instead of worshipping Allaah Who secured this safety for them, they worship their idols instead.)
v.s: Have they not seen that We made [Makkah] a safe sanctuary, while people are being taken away all around them? Then in falsehood do they believe, and in the favor of God they disbelieve?
v.c: Have they not seen how We have made ˹Mecca˺ a safe haven, whereas people ˹all˺ around them are snatched away? How can they then believe in falsehood and deny Allah’s favours?

q: Who can be more unjust than he who invents
the truth when it comes to him? Is there not an abode for the Kaafiroon in Jahannam?
(Jahannam shall certainly be their final destination.)
v.s: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about God or denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a [sufficient] residence for the disbelievers?
v.c: And who does more wrong than those who fabricate lies against Allah or reject the truth after it has reached them? Is Hell not a ˹fitting˺ home for the disbelievers?

q: We shall definitely show Our avenues
(of guidance and insight leading to Jannah)
Verily Allaah is certainly with those who do good
v.s: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, God is with the doers of good.
v.c: As for those who struggle in Our cause, We will surely guide them along Our Way. And Allah is certainly with the good-doers.
